evidence.reason: The current `scrubbedBuildEnv` filters names matching `CREDENTIAL_NAME` and `CONNECTION_NAME`, but `CREDENTIAL_NAME` only covers token/secret/password/passwd/credential/api_key/private_key/auth. `ENCRYPTION_KEY` and `SIGNING_KEY` match neither regex, so they pass through despite being credential-bearing variables, contrary to the function's documented purpose of removing every credential-bearing variable from the build environment. This is an implementation defect in existing intended behavior, not merely a request to expand scope.
